verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents its own REST API. A global token is described as valid "for managing anything within Better Stack," there are full create/update/delete endpoints for monitors with per-endpoint curl references, and the docs list Terraform for automation. However, the evidence only shows API coverage for monitors and never shows that every UI feature is available through the API. Probes found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: documented API coverage for status pages, on-call schedules, escalation policies, incidents and AI SRE features; an explicit UI-parity statement; a machine-readable OpenAPI spec; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: A global API token is a token valid across all your teams, for managing anything within Better Stack.
